_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the two spawned tests that already drove the guard's exit code before this file existed.

expectRed: blocks a production file edit and surfaces findings when the gate is active
still blocks on a corrupt gate file, substituting a parse-error message
blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
blocks a production file outside the repo root whose path contains apps/web/e2e/
blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is active
mutations.note: Forces the active-gate branch to exit 0 instead of 2 — findings are printed but the edit is no longer blocked. Reddens the corrupt-gate-file test too: it falls through to the same blocking branch once its own JSON.parse catch substitutes the parse-error message.

expectRed: allows any edit when no gate file is present
mutations.note: Removes the early no-gate-file return — the hook falls through to the blocking path, whose own catch turns a missing gate file into '(could not parse gate file)' and still blocks.

expectRed: allows a spec.ts edit under apps/web/e2e/ even when the gate is active
mutations.note: Removes the apps/web/e2e/ allowance — a spec edit under apps/web/e2e/ is blocked again while the gate is active, even though e2e-writer/red-team need to write there.

expectRed: blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
mutations.note: Removes path normalization — the raw path still starts with the apps/web/e2e/ directory, so the exemption lets a production target through.

expectRed: blocks a production file outside the repo root whose path contains apps/web/e2e/
blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is active
mutations.note: Matches an exempt directory anywhere in the path instead of under its checkout root — /vendor/apps/web/e2e/production.ts, and any worktree file under .claude/, is let through.

expectRed: blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is active
mutations.note: Drops the worktree carve-out — a production file inside .claude/worktrees/ passes as an exempt .claude path.

expectRed: allows a docs edit inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is active
mutations.note: Denies every exemption inside a worktree — the worktree's own docs/, .claude/ and apps/web/e2e/ files are blocked.
